get.summary: Read authorized inbound webhook registrations and accepted receipt summaries
get.description: Minimum role: viewer with connectors.view for each registered application and V3 environment access. The selected instance/environment scope is mandatory. Only configured Alertmanager and GitLab inbound sources with active application mappings are listed. Alertmanager count is deduplicated accepted receipts in the preceding 24 hours, and last is the last accepted 202 receipt; neither proves sender health or reports rejected requests. GitLab's historical inbox lacks an application/environment association, so its count and last are empty even when its current binding is visible. Source addresses are relative paths, never credential values. No live API token registry, outbound MCP service, source-specific delivery history, or outbound webhook delivery is connected. Outbound redelivery is disabled. The frozen frontend currently expects status ok/error and displays unknown as an error; its rendering must be aligned before page acceptance.

200.description: Available registered sources plus explicit availability of unsupported sections

count.description: Alertmanager: accepted, deduplicated receipts in the last 24 hours. GitLab: empty because historic receipt scope is unavailable

last.description: Alertmanager: empty if no accepted receipt; otherwise 202 and UTC RFC3339 receipt time. GitLab: empty because historic receipt scope is unavailable

status.description: Configuration and receipt counts do not prove sender health

503.description: Storage, environment scope, or policy cannot be checked
